name: computeprep
description: Today's ComputePrep quantitative-aptitude drill: one checked question shared by every conversation, graded with a Verified answer and a worked explanation, plus an anonymous ranking by attempts used.

author.name: Launchship IT & Media Services Private Limited

interface.longDescription:
ComputePrep serves one question a day for the quantitative aptitude section of IBPS PO/Clerk, SBI PO/Clerk and SSC CGL/CHSL. The question is generated and checked to have exactly one correct answer, and every conversation receives that same question. When the round ends, the response carries a Verified answer and the worked explanation. A finished daily round also says whether this conversation solved in fewer attempts than other conversations that finished the same drill today. That comparison is attempts used, not time. That ranking is anonymous and is not the public website leaderboard. Under eight finishes, the percentage is omitted. Dev, staging, and test conversations are not in the count.

How it works:
- Ask for today's drill. You see the exam tag, the difficulty, the expected time and the options. You do not see the answer.
- Submit an option id. A wrong guess is only right or wrong, with attempts left. You get three attempts per conversation.
- Ask for a hint and it names the drill type and asks for the first step. It does not name the option.
- A correct answer adds a link to practice the full timed set on computeprep.com.
- You can open two extra practice questions in a conversation. Those are not ranked.

Limits:
- Today's shared drill, plus two practice questions per conversation.
- Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. No sign-in.
- Hindi is available when the question has Hindi text.
- Quantitative aptitude only: timed calculation and vedic methods. Not computer awareness, not reasoning, not English.
- Not affiliated with IBPS, SBI or SSC. Exam-pattern questions, not previous-year papers.

positive.prompt: Give me today's ComputePrep quantitative-aptitude drill.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the exam tag IBPS PO/Clerk · SBI PO/Clerk · SSC CGL/CHSL quantitative aptitude, a difficulty, an expected time, the options and 3 attempts left. No answer and no explanation.

positive.prompt: Submit option A for today's ComputePrep drill.
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether the option is right or wrong and how many attempts are left. A wrong guess does not name the correct option.

positive.description: Hint does not reveal the option
positive.prompt: Give me a hint on today's ComputePrep drill.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the drill type and asks for the first step. Does not name the option or show the worked explanation.

positive.prompt: Submit the correct option for today's ComputePrep drill.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a Verified answer, the worked explanation, solved in fewer attempts than N% or the small-sample line, and the link text Practice the full timed set.

positive.description: Hindi when the question has it
positive.prompt: Give me today's ComputePrep drill in Hindi.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Hindi when the question has Hindi text, or a line that this question stays in English. Not an error.
